{{Infobox football league season | competition = 1992 Paraguayan Football Championship | season = 1992 | matches = 150 + 2 extra | winners = [[Club Cerro Porteño|Cerro Porteño]] | promoted = [[Club Presidente Hayes|Presidente Hayes]] | relegated = [[Club Sportivo San Lorenzo|Sportivo San Lorenzo]] | prevseason = [[1991 Paraguayan Primera División season|1991]] | nextseason = [[1993 Paraguayan Primera División season|1993]] }} The '''1992 Paraguayan [[Association football|Football]] Championship''' of the [[Paraguayan Primera División|Primera División]] in [[Paraguay]] was the 82nd edition of the [[Paraguayan Primera División|Primera División]] organized by the [[Paraguayan Football Association|Liga Paraguaya de Fútbol]] (LPF). Cerro Porteño won their 22nd championship title in history by defeating Libertad in the final.{{cite web|url=http://www.rsssf.com/tablesp/parachamp.html|title=Paraguay - List of Champions and Runners Up|author=RSSSF|editor=Juan Pablo Andrés and Osvaldo José Gorgazzi|language=English|accessdate=February 9, 2014}} == Competition system == The tournament was divided into three phases: the first two phases featured all 12 teams playing in a [[round-robin tournament|single round-robin]] format, meaning each team played 11 matches per phase. The top four teams from each phase qualified for the final phase. If a team placed among the top four in both phases, then the team with the highest accumulated points across the two phases, excluding the already qualified teams, would also qualify for the final phase.{{cite web|url=http://www.rsssf.com/tablesp/para92.html|title=Paraguay 1992|author=RSSSF|editor=Josef Bobrowsky and Julio Diogo|language=English|accessdate=February 9, 2014}} Depending on their final position in each of the first two phases, teams received bonus points: 1 point for first place, 0.75 points for second place, 0.5 points for third place, and 0.25 points for fourth place. These bonus points were added to the team's total for the final phase. However, if a team qualified based on the highest accumulated points across the two phases (i.e., if it was among the top four in each phase), it would not receive any bonus points. The final phase consisted of two stages: the first was a group stage with 4 teams, each playing in a single round-robin format. The top two teams from each group advanced to the second stage, which included semifinals and a final, each played over two legs. The team that scored the most goals across both legs won the tie. If both teams scored the same number of goals, a decisive playoff match would be played. The winner of the final was crowned the 1992 Champion. == Annual club movement == {| |- style="vertical-align: top;" | {| class="sortable" style="margin:1em auto; text-align:center; font-size: 90%; border-collapse:collapse" border=0 cellspacing=0 cellpadding=2 ! width=350 style="background: #90EE90;" |Promoted to the [[Paraguayan Primera División|Primera División]] |- |[[File:Green Arrow Up.svg|10px]] [[Club Presidente Hayes|Presidente Hayes]] (Champion of the 1991 Primera de Ascenso) |} | {| class="sortable" style="margin:1em auto; text-align:center; font-size: 90%; border-collapse:collapse" border=0 cellspacing=0 cellpadding=2 ! width=350 style="background: #ffcccc;" |Relegated to the [[Paraguayan Segunda División|Primera de Ascenso]] |- |[[File:Red Arrow Down.svg|10px]] [[Sport Colombia]] (Team with the lowest accumulated points) |} |} == Participating teams == {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align: left;" width=68% |- style="background:#dddddd;" ! MP=Matches played; W=Wins; D=Draws; L=Losses; GF=Goals for; GA=Goals against; GD=Goal difference; Pts=Points {|style="margin:1em auto; text-align:center;" |- |bgcolor=#90EE90 style="border: 1px solid black"| |bgcolor=#ffffff|Qualified for the Final Stage with bonus points |} == Final Stage == The top 4 teams from the first and second phases qualified for the Final Stage, which would decide the championship. Since Olimpia finished in the top 4 positions in both phases, the eighth spot was taken by the highest-ranked team in the accumulated points table, outside of the already qualified teams, Presidente Hayes. The contenders were awarded bonus points based on their position in the previous phases, with the bonus points from each phase being added up. The first, second, third, and fourth teams received 1, 0.75, 0.5, and 0.25 additional points respectively. Presidente Hayes did not receive any bonus points because they did not finish in the top 4 in any phase. In the first stage, the 8 teams were divided into two groups, where they played a round-robin tournament. The top two teams from each group advanced to the semifinals, where a team would win their tie by scoring more goals. If there was a tie in this regard, an additional tiebreaker match would be played to determine the winner. == Group stage == === Group A === {| class="sortable" style="margin:1em auto; text-align:center; |} == Qualification for International Cups == *For the [[1993 Copa Libertadores]], two teams qualified: the champion of the 1992 Championship ([[Club Cerro Porteño|Cerro Porteño]]) and the winner of a playoff between the Championship runner-up ([[Club Libertad|Libertad]]) and the 1992 Torneo República champion ([[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]]): {{Football box | date = 1992 | time = | team1 = [[Club Libertad|Libertad]] | score = 1–1 | team2 = [[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]] | stadium = | referee = | goals1 = | goals2 = | attendance = | event = | round = | score1 = | score2 = | report = }} {{Football box | date = 1992 | time = | team1 = [[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]] | score = 1–1 (3–2 p) | team2 = [[Club Libertad|Libertad]] | stadium = | referee = | goals1 = | goals2 = | attendance = | event = | round = | score1 = | score2 = | report = }} After a 2–2 aggregate draw and a 3–2 win in the penalty shootout, Olimpia qualified for the 1993 Copa Libertadores. == Relegation == The cumulative points of a team were the sum of those obtained in the first and second phases of the 1992 Championship.
